decision: Selected the area centroid of the red-line site boundary on the developer's published 'Site Location Plan' (April 2026 consultation event boards, page 7), registered to Esri World Imagery, as the campus locator for the proposed CX Technology Campus on about 55 ha north of the former Chapelcross nuclear power station. The point lies inside the traced boundary, 79 m from its nearest edge; it is not a building position, an official boundary or a surveyed point.

source_image.extraction: pdfimages -j -f 7 -l 7 (poppler): embedded JPEG object 22, 1239 x 1754 px at 150 ppi, sha256 456585771ec7f4c6a5440a22b07ca42e8624a74e08081cc0da829595bbed803b
source_image.heading: Site Location Plan
source_image.content: Aerial photograph with a red line enclosing the proposed campus land north of the former power-station buildings; no grid, scale bar, coordinates or north arrow.

reference_imagery.service: Esri World Imagery MapServer tiles (Web Mercator), zoom 16, x 32178-32185, y 20717-20724 (64 tiles), about 1.37 m per pixel at 55.02 N
reference_imagery.digest_method: sha256 over (basename bytes + sha256(tile bytes)) for the 64 tiles in sorted path order

registration.model: 4-parameter similarity (scale, rotation, translation) from site-plan pixels to imagery-mosaic pixels by least squares

control_points.feature: farm-track junction with the north-west to south-east road
north-east end of farm track at peat-moss edge
east track junction with the north-west to south-east road
west lane junction with the south-west to north-east road
field-track junction with the west lane

traced_boundary.note: Hand-traced along the plan's red line; the small separately outlined square near the northern apex is excluded. Areas are computed in EPSG:27700 after transforming the registered vertices with pyproj 3.7.1.

consistency_checks.area: The traced boundary encloses 56.1 ha; the developer's location page and 17 August 2026 post give about 55 ha, and the NDA's 19 November 2025 release gives 135 acres (54.6 ha) of the estate's unlicensed landholding adjacent to the former nuclear site.
consistency_checks.position: The boundary lies immediately north of the former power-station buildings, matching the location page ('immediately north of the former Chapelcross nuclear power station, near Annan'), about 6 km north-east of Annan.
consistency_checks.imagery: Esri World Imagery viewed locally and not redistributed: the registered red line runs along the road on the site's north-western side and the field boundaries to the north-east and east, and its inner southern edge follows tracks and field edges around the former station's built area; the traced outline was overlaid on the mosaic and inspected before the centroid was taken.

uncertainty: Registration residuals (RMS about 6 m) measure only the fit of an unscaled consultation graphic to imagery of unknown date and absolute accuracy; hand tracing and the boundary's own drafting add further unquantified error. The 55 ha site extends about 1.3 km in each direction around the point, and the plan shows no building positions.
